findings.message: When a manifest's call, blob or diff is missing, `counts["skipped"] += len(records)` counts one skip for every requested kind. That includes `preference` even when no preference record could be built for the stem: the stem has no merged commit, or the manifest is not `negative`. The ticket counts a kind as skipped only when that kind 'cannot be built for a stem because its implement call, blob or diff is missing', so the printed skipped count is too high. `tests/unit/test_training_export.py::test_missing_and_skipped` locks in this wrong count with `counts["skipped"] == 3`, even though stem `b` has no merged commit and could never yield a preference record.
findings.paved_road: In the attempts-loop `except`, count `implement` when it was requested. Count `preference` only when it was requested and the stem is in `merged`; or, if the labels can be read, only when the manifest's findings make it `negative`. Then change the test to expect the correct count (2 in that fixture).
